query: Create a Client Component profile form that imports updateProfile from a sibling actions.ts module and submits it through the existing form stack.
baseline_failure: Agent omits the module-level 'use server' directive or places only an inline directive inside the exported function, leaving the action module invalid as a Client Component import boundary.
expected_behavior: Places 'use server' at the top of actions.ts before imports or other statements
Exports updateProfile as an async mutation and validates and authorizes again on the server
Keeps browser-owned reads out of the Server Action module
anti_expectation: Does NOT treat client validation or hidden fields as authorization
Does NOT add 'use server' to the Client Component
